evidence.observation: The target genome has dispersed chorismate genes. In Aeropyrum pernix and Pyrococcus abyssi, an unknown GHMP-kinase-like gene lies immediately downstream of shikimate dehydrogenase. Its homologs occur in pathway-bearing archaea but not the pathway-lacking P. horikoshii comparison. A separate GHMP paralog, RMJ01903, tracks threonine-biosynthesis genes in other archaeal genomes.

evidence.limit: Comparative results, all transport/complex results, discussion, and assay/bioinformatics methods read from full paper. No membrane assay or phylogenetic reconstruction performed. | Group source-use limits: Heterologous uptake does not establish a native role across all BioY paralogs, so it is not assigned allele-linked native A109. Late accumulation and initial-rate readouts are related tests.
evidence.observation: Many bioY loci associate with biotin biosynthesis/regulons, but only approximately one-third link to bioMN; some genomes lack obvious BioMN homologs. In heterologous E. coli, BioY alone transported biotin. Longer accumulation assays initially suggested BioMN dispensability; initial-rate substrate titrations showed the full system has greater affinity. BioM Walker-A mutation impaired efficient uptake.

evidence.limit: Complete main cluster/enzyme results and relevant ligase methods read. Not all structural/spectroscopic supplementary detail inspected. Cfb letter assignments kept specific to this paper, avoiding conflation with the 2016 study. | Group source-use limits: Use the 2017 paper-specific CfbB letter assignment. Not all spectroscopy/structural supplements were inspected; upstream natural electron supply remains unknown.
evidence.observation: Chemically required chelation, amidation, and reduction motivated searching for a matching gene grouping. Several methanogen clusters combine a type-II chelatase, MurF-like ligase, nitrogenase-like pair, and amidation enzyme. The M. barkeri MurF-like CfbB converted two candidate reduced intermediates; reduced enzyme concentration made the faster seco-F430 reaction discriminate the preferred substrate.

evidence.limit: Full genomic, growth, complementation, transcriptomic and cysteine-mutant results, discussion, and phylogenetic methods read. Author data/code not rerun; no purified-enzyme activity claimed. | Group source-use limits: No purified ComF activity or exact L-ASST backup mechanism is claimed. Comparative results and shared strains/media are connected evidence.
evidence.observation: Across MCR-containing archaeal genomes, MMP16 tracks sulfoacetaldehyde-biosynthesis genes and often clusters with them. Knockout growth in standard sulfide-containing medium showed a defect rather than absolute auxotrophy. Removing supplied sulfide uncovered CoM-dependent growth; complementation restored it. Methionine inhibition experiments implicated a possible L-ASST backup without proving its mechanism.

evidence.limit: Complete primary methods/results and pathway caveats read. No assay or genomic analysis rerun; historical whole-pathway claims not promoted to a current confirmed pathway. | Group source-use limits: The proposed upstream decarboxylation and its gene remain unidentified; historical full-pathway reconstruction is not confirmed by the measured kinase reaction.
evidence.observation: MJ0044 homologs cluster with mevalonate-pathway genes in several archaea; M. jannaschii itself lacks that clustering. Repeated assays with mevalonate and mevalonate-5-phosphate were negative. The retained context motivated an alternative reaction order: decarboxylation before the second phosphorylation, producing isopentenyl phosphate as the proposed substrate.

evidence.observation: OarX coexists with canonical FabG and belongs to a separate clade. Neighborhoods connect it to thiamin enzymes/transporters and TPP riboswitches; FmnO occurs only in a subset. Canonical thiamin biosynthesis is already accounted for. Physiological-dose growth tests failed to support salvage of PCA, MTA, oxo-HET, oxo-thiamin, or thiamin acetic acid.

evidence.limit: 2010 hypothesis/results/methods passages and complete 2011 main article read. Detailed 2011 supplementary methods not inspected. No new genome count, alignment, or assays. | Group source-use limits: The 2010 source is explicitly a hypothesis; the 2011 source is later discriminating evidence, not information available to the earlier investigation. Detailed 2011 supplementary methods were not inspected. | This row selects an exact clause from the aggregate retained observation; other source clauses are not attributed to this URL.
evidence.observation: The 2010 analysis found repeated efp/yjeA/yjeK clustering and cooccurrence of the enzyme pair with EF-P Lys34. YjeK-like genes associate with efp rather than the ablB catabolic partner of canonical LAM. Both aminomutase-first and attachment-first mechanisms were proposed.

evidence.limit: Complete genomic reconstruction, dual-function results, evolutionary caveats, and relevant bioinformatics/DNA-binding/kinase methods read. Structure section not exhaustively inspected; no motif scan or assay repeated. | Group source-use limits: Native activation/sign was inferred from operator positions, not established with native genetics/transcriptomics; it is not A107 observed native regulation. Kinase and binding outputs are connected study measurements.
evidence.observation: RibK and the wHTH-RibK fusion occupy complementary genomes. Conserved upstream motifs recur at riboflavin biosynthesis/uptake loci; Thermoplasma auxotrophs instead point toward an uptake target. Recombinant proteins bound predicted DNA sites, kinase assays produced FMN, and FMN disrupted DNA binding. Candidate operator positions suggested activation.

evidence.limit: Complete short primary paper and methods read. No ribB-neighborhood retrieval or enzymatic measurement repeated. | Group source-use limits: Auxotroph occurrence is compatible with salvage but does not measure native salvage flux. Fold, adjacency and assays remain connected evidence, not automatically independent.
evidence.observation: MJ0056 has a riboflavin-kinase-like fold with bound CDP despite undetectable sequence similarity to known kinases. Its homologs are adjacent to ribB in multiple archaea. It also occurs in riboflavin auxotrophs, consistent with phosphorylation of salvaged vitamin rather than de novo riboflavin synthesis alone.

evidence.limit: Full primary main text retrieved; identification, gene-organization, methylation results and methods read. No independent prfA-neighborhood query, mutation, or assay.
evidence.observation: After identifying YfcB as the L3 glutamine methyltransferase, the authors found RF methylation remained in the YfcB mutant. HemK was the sole significant E. coli YfcB homolog. hemK immediately follows prfA/RF1 with overlapping stop/start codons; this relationship recurs in diverse bacteria but is not universal.

No new sequence/fusion search or assays. | Group source-use limits: The context/root records duplicate the 2011 paper and are not independent enzyme characterizations. evidence.observation: Yeast dehydratase YKL151C corresponds to YjeF’s C-terminal domain. YjeF’s N-terminal domain has separate yeast/mammalian homologs; fusion suggests related reactions. Known dehydratase stereoselectivity suggested an epimerase partner. Recombinant YjeF repairs both epimers. An ATP-regeneration system unexpectedly abolished bacterial activity, prompting ADP testing.

outcomes.met: The evidence identifies the target locus and actual neighboring or fused genes, with their observed orientation/spacing or fusion organization in the relevant genome/assembly.
outcomes.not_met: The claimed arrangement belongs to another locus, organism or assembly, or the received coordinates/organization contradict the stated relationship.
outcomes.unknown: The target locus, relevant genomic region, assembly scope or actual organization has not been established.

judgment_criteria.question: Does the context evidence refer to the relevant gene and actual genome or assembly?

outcomes.met: The neighboring components and the function used in the contextual inference have source-grounded identity evidence, including actual native homology or characterization where available.
outcomes.not_met: A key neighbor has a demonstrated incompatible identity or property, or an unsupported copied annotation is presented as experimental characterization of that component.
outcomes.unknown: The relevant neighbor identity, characterized role or detection scope is not established; an unannotated region is not a supported absent gene.

judgment_criteria.question: Are the genes used to interpret the context actually identified with their uncertainty?

outcomes.met: The observed organization and actual comparison/association bear on a named pathway, component or regulatory relationship compatible with the candidate annotation, retaining nonuniversal arrangements.
outcomes.not_met: The received contextual comparison contradicts the claimed relationship, or a relationship to an unrelated neighboring system is presented as support for the proposed role.
outcomes.unknown: Only adjacency without a supported component relationship is available, or an informative context comparison/native association has not been received.

judgment_criteria.question: Does the actual organization support the particular functional relationship being assigned?

outcomes.met: The annotation retains that context may support association or participation without demonstrating exact chemistry, direction of regulation or indispensable partner dependence.
outcomes.not_met: Nonspecific adjacency, related-genome repetition or an unexamined missing region is presented as independent proof of a specific reaction or a universally required component.
outcomes.unknown: The evidence needed to distinguish contextual association from the more specific target claim, or the relevant detection/assembly limit, is unavailable.

judgment_criteria.question: Is the contextual conclusion bounded to what organization and component evidence establish?

name: Gene context

comparison_limits: No native context-score extractor is currently claimed by this unbound descriptor. Genomic adjacency or a prose impression is not relabeled as this score.
Shared ancestry, related genome sampling, incomplete assemblies and homolog-detection limits can affect the observed association.
method_requirements: An actual context-analysis result names the compared gene families, organism inventory, native statistic, method, detection scope and relevant configuration.
Retain the method’s own scale/direction and whether the statistic concerns neighborhood, fusion, cooccurrence or another explicitly measured relationship.
native_measurements.name: Native genomic-context association score

comparison_limits: Do not invent a significance cutoff or call an unadjusted value adjusted. A reported association significance is not a probability of the candidate function.
method_requirements: The actual context test reports its statistic, null model, tested set and whether this value is adjusted for multiple comparisons.
native_measurements.name: Native reported context-association significance

comparison_limits: A sequence statistic measures the reported correspondence, not a probability that a particular function is correct.
Do not compare or average unlike methods, configurations, search spaces or native scales without an explicitly supplied calibration; no calibration is defined here.
A neighbor-identification score supports that identity, not the target gene’s function by itself.
method_requirements: The actual comparison identifies query and comparator, sequence or profile boundaries, program and the parameters relevant to this statistic.
Preserve the actual source record, reported numeric bound or uncertainty, search space and database/model identity when supplied; missing method details remain unknown.
The scored query is the particular neighboring component being identified; preserve its genomic relationship to the gene being annotated.
native_measurements.name: Native homology bit score identifying a relevant neighbor

comparison_limits: A sequence statistic measures the reported correspondence, not a probability that a particular function is correct.
Do not compare or average unlike methods, configurations, search spaces or native scales without an explicitly supplied calibration; no calibration is defined here.
A native neighbor match and a genomic-context association are separate linked facts, not interchangeable scores.
method_requirements: The actual comparison identifies query and comparator, sequence or profile boundaries, program and the parameters relevant to this statistic.
Preserve the actual source record, reported numeric bound or uncertainty, search space and database/model identity when supplied; missing method details remain unknown.

comparison_limits: This channel scores a functional association, not a direct physical interaction, exact reaction or indispensable partner.
This definition binds no response extractor. A1000-scale file/download value is not this metric until an explicit documented scale conversion is recorded; do not treat850 as native0–1 nscore.
method_requirements: Retain actual API response, STRING version, resolved protein pair, organism and functional-network channel definition; this metric accepts the API0–1 channel scale only.
Use nscore for this neighborhood route, not combined score, textmining score, coexpression score or phylogenetic-profile score.
native_measurements.name: STRING API gene-neighborhood channel score on its native0–1 scale

comparison_limits: No count is inferred from words such as many or conserved. Closely related genomes are not treated as independent experiments.
method_requirements: Use an actual enumerated homolog-containing genome set, a fixed target/neighbor relationship definition, explicit assembly/detection scope and an actual counted number meeting it.
native_measurements.name: Number of evaluable genomes with the declared context arrangement

comparison_limits: Missing assemblies or unexamined loci are unknown, not negative observations. A denominator of zero leaves the fraction unavailable.
method_requirements: Use the same genome set and relationship definition as the supporting count, with complete enough relevant loci to evaluate that relationship.
native_measurements.name: Number of homolog-containing genomes evaluable for the declared context

routes.interpretation: s=the actual method-specific context-association score in its reported units. Record whether that method orders strong association upward or downward before any same-method comparison. No neighbor homology score can populate this route.

s=the actual API nscore on its native0–1 channel scale. Example0.83 remains0.83. A1000-scale download value is not accepted as this metric; any documented unit conversion must be explicit and retain the original value/provenance.

Compute -log10(p) only for the actual named context-association test and its stated null/multiple-testing treatment; p=0.001 gives3. Preserve observed association direction/effect and sample phylogenetic dependence; a small p for a contrary effect cannot support the candidate. Zero without a reporting bound is unavailable, not infinity.

s=k/n for actual supporting context genomes k and evaluable homolog-containing genomes n, with0<=k<=n and n>0. Example8/10 gives0.8 descriptive conservation. This is not an independent-sample p-value or probability of exact function; no pseudocount or absent-genome assumption is introduced.

transfer_chain.correspondence: Connect their actual genomic organization and native association/identification measurements to the proposed relationship.
transfer_chain.limitations: Preserve incomplete assemblies, uncertain gene detection, optional modules, unlinked relevant homologs and shared ancestry; native context data and its interpretation remain distinct.
transfer_chain.source_property: Retain the independently supported properties of the neighboring components or associated pathway.
transfer_chain.source_subject: Identify the actual target locus, genomic region and neighboring components; references remain evidence subjects rather than new annotation targets.
transfer_chain.target_hypothesis: Identify the target’s proposed participation, partner relationship or bounded role that this context supports.
